source.author: Amiko
source.note: Archive AMIKO_Impulse_SAT_2.3.61_emu.zip from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-04.

simulator.note: Boots as a 128 MB M3503 revision B board (chips/m3503.py, run_dump_impulse_sat_2361_app_starts.py, run_dump_impulse_sat_2361_capture_screen.py): the XIP bootloader ("M3510B 1.1.1") runs from flash using CacheAsRam at 0x8FFF8000..0x8FFFFFFF, prints "CH455 panel init OK!", writes " ON " to the CH455 panel on GPIO 135 / 134, parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA141A7DC, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE") to 0xA6000200 and maincode(AV) ("20020A002361", 12.52 MB) to 0x80000200, and starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE EBase 0x86002001).  The application updates the CH455 panel to " on ", populates userdb(64+64) from defaultdb(PRC) over SPI, and renders its 1280x720 OSD dialog on GMA layer 0.

desc: Amiko Impulse SAT (System ID 20020A00) firmware 2.3.61 EMU (2016-4-28) for the Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver on the ALi M3510B / M3503 rev B SoC with 128 MB DDR3 and 8 MB SPI flash.
Uses an XIP CacheAsRam bootloader ("M3510B 1.1.1"), dual-CPU "M3606 SEE" firmware at 0xA6000200, and a 4-digit CH455 LED front panel on GPIO 135 (SCL) / 134 (SDA).
